title: Function Lives Where Variance Doesn't: Task-Weighted Charts of a Language Model's Computation
abstract: arXiv:2609.18989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How many dimensions does a language model's computation actually use? The question is ill-posed until one names a functional. Task-weighted charts make it well-posed: low-dimensional coordinate systems fit against a chosen functional of the representation, under the functional's own metric, turning distillation into plain least squares. Across six models from three families, spanning 70m to 7B parameters, next-token prediction needs 70--90% of the residual stream's width to stay within 5% of intact perplexity, a width consumed by the rare tail of language, and the variance profile predicts none of it: two directions carry 90% of GPT-2's activation variance and almost none of its function. Dimension is per-functional: the model's own uncertainty reads from six coordinates where the full predictive distribution needs hundreds; and it grows with depth. translated_title: 功能存在于方差不在之处：语言模型计算的任务加权图表
translated_abstract: 语言模型的计算实际上使用了多少个维度？在指明一个泛函之前，这个问题是不适定的。任务加权图表使这一问题变得适定：针对表示的选定泛函，在泛函自身的度量下拟合低维坐标系，从而将蒸馏转化为普通的最小二乘问题。在来自三个模型家族、参数量从7000万到70亿的六个模型上，下一个词预测需要残差流宽度的70%–90%才能将困惑度保持在完整模型的5%以内，而这一宽度被语言的稀有尾部所消耗，方差分布完全无法预测它：两个方向承载了GPT-2激活方差的90%，却几乎不承担任何功能。维度是依赖于泛函的：模型自身的不确定性仅需六个坐标即可读出，而完整的预测分布则需要数百个坐标；且维度随深度增长。这种分离是可利用的：当只能保留少数几个维度时，经过训练的图表……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“任务加权图表”方法，揭示了语言模型计算中功能维度与方差维度的严重分离——下一词预测需要残差流70%–90%的宽度，而GPT-2中承载90%激活方差的两个方向却几乎不承担任何功能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces task-weighted charts that reveal a sharp dissociation between function and variance in language model computation: next-token prediction requires 70–90% of the residual stream's width, while two directions carrying 90% of GPT-2's activation variance carry almost none of its function.
